pending.title: Passaging Suspension Cells
pending.summary: Subculture non-adherent mammalian cells such as Jurkat in log phase: count with trypan blue, calculate the carry-over volume, seed at a defined density by dilution or centrifugation, and feed or split every 2–3 days.

pending.title: C. elegans Strain Freezing and Thawing
pending.duration: 2 h + overnight at −80 °C; test thaw next day
pending.summary: Cryopreserve C. elegans strains as just-starved L1–L2 larvae in S buffer with 15% glycerol, cool slowly at about 1 °C/min to −80 °C, test thaw the next day and recover on OP50 plates.
pending.keywords: C. elegans freezing thawing cryopreservation glycerol S buffer L1 L2 larvae OP50 NGM -80 liquid nitrogen strain stock WormBook
